summary: April 29, 2026: FOMC voted 8-4 to hold rates at 3.50-3.75%. Powell's final meeting as chair. Third consecutive hold. Elevated inflation cited partly due to global energy prices. Four dissenters — unusual split; last time four dissented was October 1992. Markets had priced 100% probability of no change.
